# My Bilingual Blog Project

This repository contains the source code for my personal blog, built with [Eleventy](https://www.11ty.dev/) and designed for hosting on GitHub Pages.

## Features

*   Static site generated by Eleventy
*   Bilingual content (English and Bulgarian)
*   Markdown for content creation
*   Customizable theme
*   Designed for readability

## Local Development

1.  **Prerequisites:** Ensure you have [Node.js](https://nodejs.org/) (which includes npm) installed.
2.  **Clone:** `git clone https://github.com/tomsterBG/static-blog.git`
3.  **Navigate:** `cd static-blog`
4.  **Install Dependencies:** `npm install`
5.  **Run Development Server:** `npm start`
    *   This will build the site and start a local server (usually at `http://localhost:8080`).
    *   The site will automatically rebuild when you save changes to source files.
6.  **Build for Production:** `npm run build`
    *   This generates the final static site files into the `_site` directory.

## Deployment to GitHub Pages

1.  Push the contents of the `_site` directory to your `gh-pages` branch or configure GitHub Actions to build and deploy the `_site` directory from your main branch automatically.
2.  Ensure your repository settings point to the correct branch/folder for GitHub Pages hosting.
3.  If *not* using GitHub Actions or Jekyll's default build, you might need an empty file named `.nojekyll` in the root of your deployment folder/branch.
